sentences.text: The known fossil material consists of a fragment of the front left lower jaw.
Zhang Yihun first named and described this species in 1988.
The initial generic name Protognathus was already taken by a beetle, so George Olshevsky renamed it Protognathosaurus oxyodon in 1991.
This animal is classified within the suborder Sauropoda.
It belongs to the unranked family Eusauropoda.
Researchers place it in the parent group Cetiosauridae.
Protognathosaurus lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 165 to 160 million years ago.
The estimated time range for the genus extends from the Bajocian to the Oxfordian, spanning 170.9 to 154.8 million years ago.
